## What is TurboScribe AI?

TurboScribe AI is a free web tool for video to text and audio to text conversion. You give it a recording, it listens with a speech-recognition model, and it returns a transcript split into timed segments that you can edit and export.

The difference from most online transcription sites is where the work happens. Instead of sending your file to a remote server, TurboScribe AI downloads a small Whisper model to your browser once and runs it locally. That is why it needs no account, has no per-minute fee and never receives a copy of your recording.

### Audio to text

MP3, WAV, M4A and other audio files become a transcript with a timestamp on every line.

### Video to text

MP4, MOV, WEBM and MKV files have their audio track extracted automatically, then transcribed.

### Subtitles

The same timed segments export directly as SRT or VTT caption files.

## How to convert video to text or audio to text

- Add your file Drag a recording onto the converter above or click it to browse. Both audio and video files are accepted.

- Choose the spoken language English is selected by default. Switch to another language, or use Auto-detect if you are unsure.

- Press Transcribe with AI The first run downloads the speech model (about 39 MB) and caches it. After that, the file is processed in 30-second pieces and the text appears as it is produced.

- Edit the transcript Click into the Transcript view to correct names, numbers or punctuation before you export.

- Copy or download Copy the text, or download it as TXT, SRT or VTT.

## On-device transcription vs upload-based tools

Many online converters upload your recording to their servers. TurboScribe AI takes the opposite approach. This is what that changes in practice.

The trade-off is honest: a compact browser model is not as strong as a large server model on difficult audio. For clear speech it is quick, private and free.

## TXT, SRT and VTT exports

Pick the format that matches what you plan to do with the transcript.

- TXT is clean text for notes, articles, emails and search.

- SRT is the standard subtitle file for YouTube, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and most video editors.

- VTT is the WebVTT caption format used by HTML5 video players.

## On-device processing: your recording never leaves your device

When you press Transcribe, the browser decodes the audio and a WebAssembly build of the Whisper model converts speech to text on your CPU or GPU. The only thing downloaded from the network is the model and the helper libraries, and they are cached after the first use.

This makes TurboScribe AI a practical choice for recordings you would rather not hand to a third party, such as client calls, internal meetings, legal interviews or unreleased media.

Good to know: because everything runs locally, closing or reloading the tab during a transcription stops it. Keep the tab open until the progress bar reaches 100%.

## Getting accurate results

Transcript quality depends mostly on the recording. These habits make the biggest difference:

- Reduce background noise. Music, traffic and room echo are the most common causes of errors.

- Prefer one speaker at a time. Overlapping voices are hard for any speech model.

- Set the language. Choosing the spoken language is more reliable than Auto-detect on short or noisy clips.

- Check names and numbers. Proper nouns, brands and figures are where edits are most often needed.

- Use a desktop for long files. More memory means steadier processing for recordings over an hour.
